messages:
Leah: Quick heads-up  prepping QBR packet for Guardwell (insurance vertical), renewal ~5w. Need: 90s exec ask, onboarding health slide, and a one-pager risk brief. Who can pick these up? :wave:
Marcus: Ill own the 90s ask + speaker notes. Will pull ARR exposure and define ask lanes (discount vs concierge).
Ivy: Ill take onboarding health. Current completion 69% with 2 policy-engine integrations blocked. Will surface owners and short remediation timeline.
Nikhil: Support + billing feedback drove risk to 0.47. Top issues: prompt-tuning docs and SKU mapping for usage tiers.
Leah: @Nikhil can you paste 2 anonymized customer comments for the slides?
Nikhil: Snippets (anonymized): "Context window changes broke our policy routing tests" and "We need clear examples for low-cost embeddings configs."
Ivy: For onboarding fixes proposing: weekly concierge calls for 2 weeks, prebuilt policy templates, and a SSO troubleshooting playbook. Will add TTF and blocked-item ETA.
Marcus: Ill include a Dedicated-capacity fallback with rough cost delta and latency gains. Also adding a commercial concession ladder if NPS doesn't move.
EBR-bot: Reminder: Dry run scheduled Tue 9:00am PT  calendar invites sent to execs + AMs.
Leah: Keep slide count to 3. Danielle will you own the one-pager tracker? (note: Danielle out today). If unavailable, @Ivy can template.
Ivy: I can draft the one-pager and action tracker. Please add any exec-ready quotes to your slides.
Marcus: Uploaded preliminary ask doc to Drive: https://drive.redwood/qbr/guardwell-ask (will set perms). At-risk ARR est ~$95k; downside $28k.
Leah: Owner recap: Ask (Marcus), Onboarding (Ivy), One-pager & tracker (Ivy). Confirm by EOD and bring two mitigations per risk to the dry run. :thumbsup:
Ivy: Confirmed  slide draft by 3pm.
Marcus: Confirmed  will prep a 90s script and a backup offer.
Nikhil: Confirmed  will attach anonymized comments and NPS trend.
Leah: Thanks team  well rehearse handoffs at the dry run. See you Tues. :calendar:
